g.text: FanCtrl3 Lite - the same controller built from modules on a PC-3 perfboard

g.desc: FanCtrl3 Lite - the same controller built from modules on a PC-3 perfboard

g.text: Same pinout and firmware as Pro: GP0/1 fan 1, GP2/3 fan 2, GP4/5 fan 3, GP6 DS18B20

g.desc: Same pinout and firmware as Pro: GP0/1 fan 1, GP2/3 fan 2, GP4/5 fan 3, GP6 DS18B20

g.text: U2 Pololu U3V16F12: fixed 12 V; C1 >= 33 uF at its input as Pololu recommends

g.desc: U2 Pololu U3V16F12: fixed 12 V; C1 >= 33 uF at its input as Pololu recommends

g.text: PWM: NPN open collector - GPIO high = transistor on = fan slower;

g.desc: PWM: NPN open collector - GPIO high = transistor on = fan slower;

g.text: MCU dead -> base pulled to GND by 10k -> fan runs 100% (safe)

g.desc: MCU dead -> base pulled to GND by 10k -> fan runs 100% (safe)

g.text: Tach pulled up to 3V3 on fan side, 10k series to GPIO

g.desc: Tach pulled up to 3V3 on fan side, 10k series to GPIO

g.text: U3 TPS2553 on a SparkFun BOB-00717 adapter under the Pico, as on Pro:

g.desc: U3 TPS2553 on a SparkFun BOB-00717 adapter under the Pico, as on Pro:

g.text: limit 465-570 mA (R14 = 51k), ~FAULT -> GP7, EN <- GP8 (R16 keeps it on)

g.desc: limit 465-570 mA (R14 = 51k), ~FAULT -> GP7, EN <- GP8 (R16 keeps it on)

g.text: Pico on raw VBUS; only the 12 V converter is behind the limiter

g.desc: Pico on raw VBUS; only the 12 V converter is behind the limiter
